Hello, world (sample post)

25 November 2026 · 2 min read

This is a sample post. It exists to check that the blog pipeline works end to end: headings, code blocks, tables, images and links. Delete it (or mark it draft: true) once there is a real article to replace it.

How this blog is built #

Every article is a Markdown file in the posts/ folder. A small build script turns those files into static HTML in dist/, and a GitHub Actions workflow publishes that folder to GitHub Pages.

Links between pages are written as links between Markdown files, for example the About page, and are rewritten at build time.

Code blocks #

Fenced code blocks are highlighted at build time, so no JavaScript runs in the reader’s browser. Inline code such as deltaTime works too.

C# #

public sealed class FixedTimestep
{
    private const double Step = 1.0 / 60.0;
    private double _accumulator;

    public void Advance(double deltaTime, Action<double> simulate)
    {
        _accumulator += Math.Min(deltaTime, 0.25); // avoid the spiral of death
        while (_accumulator >= Step)
        {
            simulate(Step);
            _accumulator -= Step;
        }
    }
}

C++ #

#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

template <typename T>
class SparseSet {
public:
    bool contains(std::uint32_t id) const {
        return id < sparse_.size() && sparse_[id] < dense_.size() && dense_[sparse_[id]] == id;
    }

private:
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> sparse_;
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> dense_;
    std::vector<T> values_;
};

TypeScript #

type Vec2 = { x: number; y: number };

export const lerp = (a: Vec2, b: Vec2, t: number): Vec2 => ({
  x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t,
  y: a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t,
});

Shaders #

Texture2D SpriteTexture : register(t0);
SamplerState SpriteSampler : register(s0);

float4 MainPS(float4 position : SV_Position, float4 color : COLOR0, float2 uv : TEXCOORD0) : SV_Target
{
    float4 texel = SpriteTexture.Sample(SpriteSampler, uv);
    return lerp(texel, texel * color, 0.5);
}

#version 330 core
in vec2 vUv;
out vec4 fragColor;
uniform sampler2D uTexture;

void main() {
    fragColor = texture(uTexture, vUv);
}
